Explore one of the most peaceful places in Bangladesh — Rangamati 🇧🇩
Rangamati is one of the most beautiful travel destinations in Bangladesh, known for its hills, lakes, and natural environment. In this video, we explore a complete Rangamati 1 day tour plan, including the famous Shuvolong Waterfall and other popular tourist spots.

If you're planning a trip to Rangamati, this video will give you a real idea of what to expect — from boat rides to scenic views.

📍 Location: Rangamati, Chittagong, Bangladesh
🎥 Travel • Nature • বাংলাদেশ ভ্রমণ

Watch till the end for the full experience.

Welcome to our cinematic travel vlog from Kaptai Lake, Rangamati, Bangladesh 🇧🇩 — one of the most breathtaking travel destinations in South Asia! 🌿

In this video, we explore the Kaptai Lake camping experience, Mayaleen & Sukher Tori Houseboat tour, and the mesmerizing Shuvolong Waterfall (Shuvolong Jhorna) — a true hidden gem of Bangladesh. 🌊

From the Kaptai Nishorgo Pod House to the Kaptai Navy Camp, every frame captures the raw natural beauty and peaceful vibe of Rangamati’s hill tracks.
If you love adventure, nature, and travel, this vlog is made for you!

📍 Highlights in this video:
🚤 Houseboat ride on Kaptai Lake
🏕️ Camping under the stars
🌊 Visit to Shuvolong Waterfall
🌅 Stunning drone shots of Kaptai Lake
🍃 A short trip through the Kaptai-Chittagong road
🌄 Explore Kaptai Lake resort, Nishorgo Pod House & Navy Camp
📌 Watch till the end for beautiful Kaptai Lake 4K drone shots and amazing Bangladesh nature scenes!
